scientific_limitations: Only this frozen model pair and stress condition are tested.
Seed variation in structured filler is limited to the deterministic generator; independence beyond this synthetic cohort is unestablished.
Wilson intervals and McNemar assume independent seed pairs; repeated budgets are not independent confirmatory tests.
State comparisons are observational, not causal.
